title: A mutex as a water tower and key
label: Water tower on a kerbed plinth: staved, hooped tank and ribbed roof on braced legs, ladder, level gauge and valve stand; two pumps feed straight risers; a two-dial console holds the one key. Hover across to step.
caption: Both controllers read the level and top up the gap. Without the key both read 793 L, both pump 207 L and the tank spills; when A holds the key, B waits and the tank fills once.
